parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a canonical sample-app location that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint. The production copy of 'DebugMetricsProvider.handleDisplayLinkTick' belongs to the 'DebugPanel' package; the second copy is a local convenience duplicate inside the Wallpaper sample app's debug HUD. Consolidating these would couple the sample app's debug overlay to the production 'DebugPanel' package, which is an undesirable dependency direction. The duplication is intentional: the sample app maintains its own self-contained debug instrumentation.
